essentialEvidence: Confirm the final 30 EC for September 2026 National Politics and Government entrants, including credits and status of the three named final-year courses, the applicable thesis allocation and progression, and any third-year mentorship.
officialAlternative: The faculty index links to its Dutch-track 2026–2027 transition document. The document gives course substitutions including Netherlands in Europe, both methods courses, both research projects and Democracy and Rule of Law. It supplies no new-cohort third-year allocation. The 2025–2026 and 2026–2027 Dutch Study Guide tables both list S_WF 6 EC, S_CPT 6 EC, S_BTPNPB 18 EC and S_MP3 0 EC for the year-three route now taught. Exact current entries confirm these credits and one required mentorship meeting with a preparatory assignment. The thesis entry requires 90 EC excluding electives, refers to the older workshop names, and describes individual empirical research with a methods exam and proposal before continuing. Adopted OER Article 9.1 names Academic Skills 1 and 2, but Appendix III p. 29 expressly labels the final-year table for entrants through 2024–2025. The next two programme API editions yielded 204 without a body and the exact thesis page URLs returned 404. No official evidence connected the published final-year allocation and mentorship to September 2026 entrants.
